svg.title: Reduction by symmetry: the first-quadrant point P(x,y) at angle alpha is reflected across the y-axis to P'(-x,y) at angle pi minus alpha, rotated a half-turn to P'(-x,-y) at angle pi plus alpha, and reflected across the x-axis to P'(x,-y) at angle 2 pi minus alpha
